text:
Rohit Kapoor: Heads up — nightly h100 job turned red on shard 12. Seeing repeated kernel timeouts and a couple of OOMs in quant-attention tests. logs: https://ci.internal/red/2267778888/shard12 :(
Jamal Price: Which image + driver on that runner? Could be a driver/runtime skew after the image rebuild yesterday.
Rohit Kapoor: Looks like the image is edge-nightly:container:2026-03-16, nvidia driver reported by runner is `535.86.05` but container libcuda shows `534.21` in the crash log.
Anya Venkataraman: yeah that mismatch smells like the driver/ABI issue. Quick grep from the failing shard:
```
[2026-03-16T03:12:01Z] ERR kernel: cuCtxCreate failed: invalid device function
[2026-03-16T03:12:01Z] WARN run: failed to init attention kernel, falling back
[2026-03-16T03:12:02Z] ERR mem: out of memory allocating 1.2GB
```
Marie Chen: @ci-bot can you trigger a rerun on a node pinned to driver 535.86.05 host + matching container libs? We should also capture nvidia-smi and `ldconfig -p | grep libcuda` output.
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: job 2267778888 -> rerun 2267778888.2 on pool h100-driver-535 at 03:18 UTC. Notifying assignees.
Jamal Price: Great. If rerun passes, we can blame the image rebuild. If it fails again, request a bisect across the driver matrix + CUDA minor versions.
Rohit Kapoor: I'll collect the failing core dump and send a short repro script. Quick triage note: affected test is `tests/integration/quant_attn_smoke.py::test_beam_search_parallel` — reprod is cheap locally on 4 tokens so easy to iterate.
Anya Venkataraman: Also add a short note to the release that we reverted host-driver bump on the h100 pool until we confirm. Tagging infra for visibility: @Jenny-Infra to pause the driver rollout.
Marie Chen: If the rerun is green, we still should run a driver-compat smoke matrix on the next nightly to confirm stability. +1 on bisect plan if flaky.
Rohit Kapoor: thanks all — I'll post a short follow-up with artifacts & repro link once rerun completes.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: 2267778888.2 -> status: failed (kernel timeout) on host h100-12. Full logs: https://ci.internal/red/2267778888/shard12/rerun2/logs
Jamal Price: Ok rerun also failed — moving to bisect. Can infra give us a span of recent driver changes and which hosts got bumped? @Jenny-Infra?
Anya Venkataraman: I'll start the bisect template: trying 534.21 -> 535.86.05 and note CUDA 12.2 vs 12.1 permutations. I'll also try a small kernel compile check for device function symbol exports.
Marie Chen: Thanks — please paste bisect commands here if you want someone to run them. I can help run on the spare h100-compat pool.
Rohit Kapoor: putting the repro + short runbook at https://confluence/internal/eng-ml/ci-h100-driver-bisect. Will update when bisect narrows it down.
